Southeast Booth|Sign|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Color TotK|Map Blue|'''Sand-Seal Rental Shop'''}}|Map|TotK}} ==Features and Overview== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Sand-Seal Rental Shops are a variety of [[Shop]] that exists only within [[Gerudo Town]]. Their purpose is to rent trained [[Sand Seal]]s to people heading into the [[Gerudo Desert]].{{Cite|We run a shop where we rent out {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seals}}. If you plan on crossing the desert, you'll need a {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seal}}!|Kohm|BotW}} The [[Sand-Seal Rental Shop Southeast Booth]] is located near the [[Southeast Gate]] and operated [[Essa]] and [[Frelly]], while the [[Sand-Seal Rental Shop Northwest Booth]] is situated near the [[Northwest Gate]] and operated by [[Kohm]]. The Shops' Sand Seals are trained by Frelly to be faster than their wild counterparts, and they also do not run away if their rider dismounts them.{{Cite|The {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seals}} here were all trained by Frelly. They're faster, and they'll wait for you to return to them. By comparison, the ones outside who haven't been trained will just run off the moment you dismount.|Essa|BotW}}{{Cite|Of course, our {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seals}} have all been trained. They're much easier to handle than a {{Color BotW|Blue|sand seal}} you'd find in the wild.|Kohm|BotW}} It costs [[Link]] 20 [[Rupee]]s to rent a Sand Seal, although he can pay 50 Rupees to receive a [[Wooden Shield]] that he can use while [[Sand-Seal Surfing]].{{Cite|Vasaaq! If you are hoping to cross the vast Gerudo Desert, sand-seal surfing is the way to do it! It's only {{Color BotW|Red|20 rupees}} to rent one! Need a shield, too? Just pay {{Color BotW|Red|50 rupees}}! What do you say?|Frelly|BotW}}{{Cite|[Let's seal the deal!] Oh, um... Do you not have a {{Color BotW|Blue|shield}} You can't ride the sands without a shield. Can you imagine the pain of a sand seal dragging your unshielded body over the hot, rough sand? Ouch. Look, I can sell you a nice {{Color BotW|Blue|shield}} for {{Color BotW|Red|50 rupees}}. What do you say?|Kohm|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== The Sand-Seal Rentals Shops in [[Gerudo Town]] return in {{TotK}}. They have also been renamed to the [[Sand-Seal Rental Shop East Gate Booth]] and the [[Sand-Seal Rental Shop West Gate Booth]]. However, due to the [[Sand Shroud]] covering the [[Gerudo Desert]], they are not operational until the [[Main Quest]] "[[Riju of Gerudo Town]]" has been completed. [[Frelly]] is in charge of the East Gate Booth, while [[Essa]] manages the West Gate Booth. In addition to these two [[Shop]]s, a new Sand-Seal Rental Shop run by [[Kohm]] can be found near the entrance to the Gerudo Desert. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Sand-Seal Rental Shop Southeast Booth.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}The Sand-Seal Rental Shop Southeast Booth File:TotK Sand-Seal Rental Shop West Gate Booth.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}The Sand-Seal Rental Shop West Gate Booth File:TotK Sand-Seal Rental Shop East Gate Booth.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}The Sand-Seal Rental Shop East Gate Booth ==See Also== {{See Also| * Gerudo Desert * Sand-Seal Rental Shop East Gate Booth * Sand-Seal Rental Shop West Gate Booth * Shop }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Gerudo Desert, Gerudo Town, Shops |locations= BotW, TotK }}
